row.team_price_text: Starter: Talk to sales (5 complimentary licenses)
row.evidence: Sendoso's Compare Plans feature table ticks SCIM User Management only for Enterprise (Talk to sales), while its SSO guide says SSO is included in the Core, Advanced, and Enterprise Plans.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Four plans (Starter, Core, Advanced, Enterprise), all 'Talk to sales' with no public prices, so price fields are null. Plan ticks for SSO (Core+), Sendoso API (Advanced+), Admin Audit Log and SCIM User Management (Enterprise only) were read from the check/cross icons in the Feature Comparison table markup. SCIM 2.0 API at app.sendoso.com/api/scim/v2/Users uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code (2-hour access tokens, SCIM client id/secret from developers@sendoso.com); documented operations are list, create and PUT update (active=false deactivates); no DELETE, PATCH or Groups. Okta's OIN Sendoso app is the only documented SCIM IdP (Create, Update, Deactivate); Entra, Google and OneLogin guides cover SSO only. Core REST API can list users, invite users and list teams.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 5 complimentary licenses, 100 sends/month. Ticks read from the Feature Comparison table icons.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Pricing table lists an 'Admin Audit Log' on Enterprise only; no audit-log API is documented.

auth.token_source: SCIM-specific client id and secret obtained from developers@sendoso.com; OAuth authorization-code flow (scope scim). In Okta: Provisioning > Configure API Integration > Authenticate with Sendoso.
auth.token_expiry: 2 hours (7200 s access token; refresh token expires only when used)

endpoints.notes: The SCIM reference lists only Get All Users, Get Single User, Create User and Update User; no Groups or discovery endpoints are documented.

operations.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via PUT with active. Team assignment uses the 'division' user attribute, not SCIM Groups. Okta OIN app lists Create, Update, Deactivate only (no Group Push).

custom.how: Non-standard 'division' attribute sets the user's Sendoso team and must match the team name exactly.

roles.how: userType attribute maps to the Sendoso role (SCIM reference: sender, manager, admin; Okta guide also lists department_admin). Defaults to sender when empty.

rate_limits.text: Rate limited; exceeding the limit returns 429 Too Many Requests. No numeric limit published.

limitations.text: If division is empty, the SCIM-provisioned user is not added to any team and must be added manually.
SCIM credentials are issued by Sendoso support, not self-served in the admin UI.

capabilities.notes: Invite sets role (regular or manager) and team; groups are listed only. get_user covers only the current authorised user (/me).

endpoints.purpose: List active users (paginated, max 100 per page)
Invite a new user to a team group
List users in a team group

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks cover send status events only.

rate_limits.text: Rate limited; exceeding the limit returns 429 Too Many Requests. No numeric limit published.

okta.notes: OIN page markup ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (last updated Feb. 12 2024).

entra.notes: Vendor guide uses an Entra app registration (OIDC via Auth0) and support completes setup; no Entra gallery tutorial found (404).

google.notes: Google OAuth 2.0 client set up by the customer; SSO only.

onelogin.notes: Vendor guide uses OneLogin's generic SAML Test Connector.

jumpcloud.notes: jumpcloud.com integration URL returned 403; vendor documents a generic custom SAML connection.

fallbacks.other_sync: Rippling integration syncs employee records for HR gifting automations (recipients, not Sendoso users) and can act as SSO provider.

SCIM filtering, PATCH, DELETE and Groups support are not documented.
